subject: Your 600 new friends are waiting
preview_text: You are not alone — 600+ people are healing with Fresh Start right now. See what they're doing differently.
body_paragraphs: There is a moment in every breakup where you feel like you are the only one losing sleep. The only one replaying that conversation. The only one who cannot let go. But here is what I have learned from building this: you are not alone. In fact, you are part of a growing group of 600+ people who decided to do this differently. To heal on their own terms. To stop obsessing and start moving forward.

Every day, I see people in this community logging in at 2AM when the spiral hits, using the AI therapist to talk through the noise. I see them hitting no-contact streaks, tracking their moods, and writing out what they actually deserve. And the wild part? The average recovery time in this group is 40% faster than going it alone. That is not a coincidence. That is what happens when you stop pretending you have to figure it out by yourself.

Inside Fresh Start, there is a feature called the Healing Hub — it is where you can see real stories from others who were right where you are now. People who felt lost, then used the guided exercises to find themselves again. People who thought they would never stop thinking about their ex, then used the no-contact streak tracker to prove themselves wrong. You have already downloaded the app. Now you just need to see that you are part of something bigger.

Open the app and go to the Healing Hub. Scroll through one story — just one. Then close it. Or stay for five. Your choice. But know this: you are not alone in this moment. P.S. The 3AM moments are the hardest. But the app has an emergency mode for exactly that. You never have to go through those alone again.
